panels.name: The Deadmines / Mast Room / Goblin Foundry

markers.to: 01: I ↔ II; cannon door to Ironclad Cove
01: II ↔ III; ascent to the upper deck

uncertain: The dashed swimming shortcut in II is documented, but its precise landing beside the ship approach needs in-game verification.
The dashed connection to T represents the exit ledge beside the ship; its precise height and access geometry need in-game verification.
notes: Only the instanced dungeon is shown. Outer-mine quest locations are outside this sheet.
Miner Johnson is a rare spawn.
Bosses 3 and 4 are consecutive phases of the same encounter in the Mast Room.
Cookie can be visited before the upper deck or after Edwin VanCleef; this numbering uses the former route.
Q1 is loot from boss 3. Q2 and Q3 are loot from boss 9; leader lines offset their labels.
The small alcove before A contains Defias Gunpowder for the cannon; it is an interaction, not a quest location.
The upper deck is enlarged in III. Panels are schematic and not to scale.
